name: Amunet-Ana
source:
Guardian of her people, wielding the power of the Hidden Sun, Amunet-Ana is neither truly robot nor golem, a being of magic and technology both. I know her from Study Hall, where she's "gaining knowledge." She seems to like Cool people.

[From in-game profile]
